extraction.Name: Luther Arcoran
extraction.Recorded patent: A certified copy of the patent was reported April 2, 1920; receipt for the same was signed June 17, 1920 by E. O. Frescoin
extraction.Buyer: Luther Arcoran and Lillian Arcoran conveyed the land to Edward L. McHenry for a consideration of $12,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739691 issued; southeast quarter of section 19, township 100, range 76; levy on the land April 3, 1920 to recover $3500.00 started by William I. Bordeaux, sheriff of Tripp Co.; notice afterwards given of cancellation of the levy provided by Section 2452 Revised Code of South Dakota, 1919; conveyance dated April 14, 1920 on account of a sale and exchange of the land; Jas. W. Cross listed in document; Lillian Arcoran also signed conveyance
